name: section_heading
label: Section Heading
help_text: Heading shown above the referrals table/cards.

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag. Use H1 only once per page for the main title.

name: crm_object_type
label: CRM Object Type Name
help_text: Internal API name of the CRM object. Default is 'COURSE' — the built-in Courses object (type ID 0-410) used for referrals, offers, and rewards.

name: crm_query
label: CRM Query Filter
help_text: HubSpot CRM filter string for fetching referrals. Filters to record_type=Referral records that have a status set — excludes offer/reward records.

name: crm_properties
label: CRM Properties to Fetch
help_text: Comma-separated list of CRM property API names to fetch. Must match exact property names on your CRM object.

name: col_name_label
label: Column: Name
help_text: Table column header for the referred person's name.

name: col_date_label
label: Column: Referred On
help_text: Table column header for the date the referral was made.

name: col_status_label
label: Column: Status
help_text: Table column header for referral status (Invitation Sent / Registered / Completed / Expired).

name: col_rewards_label
label: Column: Reward
help_text: Table column header for the reward earned on this referral.

name: reward_pending_label
label: Reward — Pending Approval Label
help_text: Shown in the Reward column when the referral status is Registered (awaiting approval).

name: reward_awaiting_label
label: Reward — Awaiting Reward Label
help_text: Shown in the Reward column when the referral is Completed but reward points haven't been set yet.

name: reward_expired_label
label: Reward — Expired Label
help_text: Shown in the Reward column when the referral has expired.

name: points_suffix
label: Points Suffix
help_text: Suffix appended after the points number on a completed referral (e.g. "+10 Points").

name: empty_state_text
label: Empty State Text
help_text: Message shown when no referrals are found or CRM object type is not yet configured.
default: You haven't made any referrals yet.
